shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं निशम्य परमाद्भुतम् । सुप्रीतश्चाभवद्रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.53.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṃ niśamya paramādbhutam | suprītaścābhavadrāmo vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.53.1 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, निशम्य having heard, परमाद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful, सुप्रीतः very pleased, च and, अभवत् became, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् word, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard that exceedingly wonderful speech of Lakshmana, Rama became very pleased and indeed spoke these words.
comments: Troubled that his neglect of public affairs is itself a sin, Rama bids Lakshmana summon the officers and petitioners -- he tells the cautionary tale of King Nrga, who for failing to give audience to two brahmins disputing over a gift-cow was cursed to live as a lizard until a later age -- and he charges Lakshmana to attend to every suitor.

shloka_text: दुर्लभस्त्वीदृशो बन्धुरस्मिन्काले विशेषतः । यादृशस्त्वं महाबुद्धेर्मम सौम्य मनो ऽनुगः ।। 7.53.2 ।।
transliteration: durlabhastvīdṛśo bandhurasminkāle viśeṣataḥ | yādṛśastvaṃ mahābuddhermama saumya mano 'nugaḥ || 7.53.2 ||
translation: दुर्लभः rare, तु indeed, ईदृशः such, बन्धुः a kinsman, अस्मिन् काले in this time, विशेषतः especially, यादृशः such as, त्वम् you, महाबुद्धेः O greatly intelligent one, मम my, सौम्य O gentle one, मनः अनुगः following the mind.
explanation: Indeed, such a kinsman as you, O greatly intelligent and gentle one, who follows my mind, is rare to find, especially in these times.

shloka_text: यच्च मे हृदये किञ्चिद्वर्तते शुभलक्षण । तन्निशामय च श्रुत्वा कुरुष्व वचनं मम ।। 7.53.3 ।।
transliteration: yacca me hṛdaye kiñcidvartate śubhalakṣaṇa | tanniśāmaya ca śrutvā kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama || 7.53.3 ||
translation: यत् what, च and, मे my, हृदये in the heart, किञ्चित् something, वर्तते exists, शुभलक्षण O one with auspicious marks, तत् that, निशामय listen carefully, च and, श्रुत्वा having heard, कुरुष्व do, वचनम् command, मम my.
explanation: O one with auspicious marks, listen carefully to what is in my heart, and having heard it, carry out my command.

shloka_text: चत्वारो दिवसाः सौम्य कार्यं पौरजनस्य वै । अकुर्वाणस्य सौमित्रे तन्मे मर्माणि कृन्तति ।। 7.53.4 ।।
transliteration: catvāro divasāḥ saumya kāryaṃ paurajanasya vai | akurvāṇasya saumitre tanme marmāṇi kṛntati || 7.53.4 ||
translation: चत्वारो four, दिवसाः days, सौम्य O gentle one, कार्यं work, पौरजनस्य of the citizens, वै indeed, अकुर्वाणस्य of one who neglects, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, तत् that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts.
explanation: O gentle Lakshmana, the neglect of the citizens' work for four days indeed pierces my vital parts.

shloka_text: आहूयन्तां प्रकृतयः पुरोधा मन्त्रिणस्तथा । कार्यार्थिनश्च पुरुषाः स्त्रियश्च पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.53.5 ।।
transliteration: āhūyantāṃ prakṛtayaḥ purodhā mantriṇastathā | kāryārthinaśca puruṣāḥ striyaśca puruṣarṣabha || 7.53.5 ||
translation: आहूयन्तां let them be called, प्रकृतयः the principal officers, पुरोधा the chief priest, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, तथा and, कार्यार्थिनः those seeking justice, च and, पुरुषाः men, स्त्रियः women, च and, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: O best among men, let the principal officers, the chief priest, the ministers, and also the men and women seeking justice be summoned.

shloka_text: पौरकार्याणि यो राजा न करोति दिने दिने । संवृते नरके घोरे पतितो नात्र संशयः ।। 7.53.6 ।।
transliteration: paurakāryāṇi yo rājā na karoti dine dine | saṃvṛte narake ghore patito nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.53.6 ||
translation: पौरकार्याणि the affairs of the citizens, यः who, राजा king, न not, करोति does, दिने दिने day by day, संवृते in an enclosed, नरके hell, घोरे terrible, पतितः fallen, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.
explanation: There is no doubt that a king who does not attend to the affairs of his citizens daily falls into a terrible, enclosed hell.

shloka_text: श्रूयते हि पुरा राजा नृगो नाम महायशाः । बभूव पृथिवीपालो ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवाक् शुचिः ।। 7.53.7 ।।
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā rājā nṛgo nāma mahāyaśāḥ | babhūva pṛthivīpālo brahmaṇyaḥ satyavāk śuciḥ || 7.53.7 ||
translation: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, राजा king, नृगः Nṛga, नाम named, महायशाः very famous, बभूव was, पृथिवीपालः a protector of the earth, ब्रह्मण्यः devoted to Brahmins, सत्यवाक् truthful, शुचिः pure.
explanation: Indeed, it is heard that formerly there was a very famous king named Nṛga, a protector of the earth, who was devoted to Brahmins, truthful, and pure.

shloka_text: स कदाचिद्गवां कोटीः सवत्साः स्वर्णभूषिताः । नृदेवो भूमिदेवेभ्यः पुष्करेषु ददौ नृपः ।। 7.53.8 ।।
transliteration: sa kadācidgavāṃ koṭīḥ savatsāḥ svarṇabhūṣitāḥ | nṛdevo bhūmidevebhyaḥ puṣkareṣu dadau nṛpaḥ || 7.53.8 ||
translation: सः he, कदाचित् once, गवां of cows, कोटीः crores, सवत्साः with their calves, स्वर्णभूषिताः adorned with gold, नृदेवः the king, भूमिदेवेभ्यः to the Brahmins, पुष्करेषु at Pushkara, ददौ gave, नृपः the king.
explanation: That king, Nṛga, once at Pushkara, gave crores of cows, along with their calves and adorned with gold, to the Brahmins.

shloka_text: ततः सङ्गाद्गता धेनुः सवत्सा स्पर्शिता ऽनघ । ब्राह्मणस्याहिताग्नेश्च दरिद्रस्योञ्छवर्तिनः ।। 7.53.9 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṅgādgatā dhenuḥ savatsā sparśitā 'nagha | brāhmaṇasyāhitāgneśca daridrasyoñchavartinaḥ || 7.53.9 ||
translation: ततः then, सङ्गात् from association, गता went, धेनुः the cow, सवत्सा with its calf, स्पर्शिता touched/taken, अनघ O sinless one, ब्राह्मणस्य of a Brahmana, आहिताग्नेः who maintains sacred fires, च and, दरिद्रस्य of a poor man, उञ्छवर्तिनः who lives by gleaning,
explanation: O sinless one, then that cow with its calf, having come into contact, was taken by a poor Brahmana who maintained sacred fires and lived by gleaning.

shloka_text: स नष्टां गां क्षुधार्तो वै अन्विषंस्तत्र तत्र च । नापश्यत्सर्वराज्येषु संवत्सरगणान्बहून् ।। 7.53.10 ।।
transliteration: sa naṣṭāṃ gāṃ kṣudhārto vai anviṣaṃstatra tatra ca | nāpaśyatsarvarājyeṣu saṃvatsaragaṇānbahūn || 7.53.10 ||
translation: सः he, नष्टां lost, गां cow, क्षुधार्तः afflicted by hunger, वै indeed, अन्विषन् searching, तत्र तत्र here and there, च and, न not, अपश्यत् saw, सर्वराज्येषु in all kingdoms, संवत्सरगणान् groups of years, बहून् many,
explanation: Afflicted by hunger, he searched for his lost cow here and there in all kingdoms for many years but could not find it.

shloka_text: ततः कनखलं गत्वा जीर्णवत्सां निरामयाम् । ददर्श गां स्वकां धेनुं ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ।। 7.53.11 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kanakhalaṃ gatvā jīrṇavatsāṃ nirāmayām | dadarśa gāṃ svakāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇasya niveśane || 7.53.11 ||
translation: ततः then, कनखलं to Kanakhala, गत्वा having gone, जीर्णवत्सां whose calf was old, निरामयाम् healthy, ददर्श he saw, गां the cow, स्वकां his own, धेनुं cow, ब्राह्मणस्य of the Brahmana, निवेशने in the dwelling,
explanation: Then, having gone to Kanakhala, he saw his own cow, whose calf had grown old and was healthy, in the dwelling of the Brahmana.

shloka_text: अथ तां नामधेयेन स्वकेनोवाच स द्विजः । आगच्छ शबलेत्येवं सा तु शुश्राव गौः स्वरम् ।। 7.53.12 ।।
transliteration: atha tāṃ nāmadheyena svakenovāca sa dvijaḥ | āgaccha śabaletyevaṃ sā tu śuśrāva gauḥ svaram || 7.53.12 ||
translation: अथ then, तां her, नामधेयेन by name, स्वकेन his own, उवाच said, सः that, द्विजः Brahmana, आगच्छ come, शबलेति O Shabala, एवं thus, सा she, तु indeed, शुश्राव heard, गौः the cow, स्वरम् the voice,
explanation: Then that Brahmana called her by her own name, saying, "Come, Shabala!" and the cow indeed heard his voice.

shloka_text: तस्य तं स्वरमाज्ञाय क्षुधार्तस्य द्विजस्य वै । अन्वगात्पृष्ठतः सा गौर्गच्छन्तं पावकोपमम् ।। 7.53.13 ।।
transliteration: tasya taṃ svaramājñāya kṣudhārtasya dvijasya vai | anvagātpṛṣṭhataḥ sā gaurgacchantaṃ pāvakopamam || 7.53.13 ||
translation: तस्य his, तं that, स्वरं voice, आज्ञाय having recognized, क्षुधार्तस्य of the hungry, द्विजस्य Brahmana, वै indeed, अन्वगात् followed, पृष्ठतः from behind, सा she, गौः the cow, गच्छन्तं him who was going, पावकोपमम् like fire,
explanation: Having recognized the voice of that hungry Brahmana, the cow indeed followed him from behind as he, radiant like fire, walked away.

shloka_text: यो ऽपि पालयते विप्रः सो ऽपि गामन्वगाद्द्रुतम् । गत्वा तमृषिमाचष्ट मम गौरिति सत्वरम् ।। 7.53.14 ।।
transliteration: yo 'pi pālayate vipraḥ so 'pi gāmanvagāddrutam | gatvā tamṛṣimācaṣṭa mama gauriti satvaram || 7.53.14 ||
translation: यः who, अपि also, पालयते protects, विप्रः brahmin, सः he, अपि also, गाम् cow, अन्वगात् followed, द्रुतम् quickly, गत्वा having gone, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, आचष्ट told, मम my, गौः cow, इति thus, सत्वरम् quickly.
explanation: The brahmin who was tending the cow also quickly followed it, and having gone, swiftly told that sage, "This is my cow."

shloka_text: स्पर्शिता राजसिंहेन मम दत्ता नृगेण ह । तयोर्ब्राह्मणयोर्वादो महानासीद्विपश्चितोः ।। 7.53.15 ।।
transliteration: sparśitā rājasiṃhena mama dattā nṛgeṇa ha | tayorbrāhmaṇayorvādo mahānāsīdvipaścitoḥ || 7.53.15 ||
translation: स्पर्शिता touched, राजसिंहेन by the lion among kings, मम my, दत्ता given, नृगेण by Nṛga, ह indeed, तयोः of those two, ब्राह्मणयोः brahmins, वादः dispute, महान् great, आसीत् was, विपश्चितोः learned.
explanation: One brahmin claimed the cow was touched by the king, while the other insisted it was given to him by Nṛga, leading to a great dispute between the two learned brahmins.

shloka_text: विवदन्तौ ततो ऽन्योन्यं दातारमभिजग्मतुः । तौ राजभवनद्वारि न प्राप्तौ नृगशासनम् ।। 7.53.16 ।।
transliteration: vivadantau tato 'nyonyaṃ dātāramabhijagmatuḥ | tau rājabhavanadvāri na prāptau nṛgaśāsanam || 7.53.16 ||
translation: विवदन्तौ disputing, ततः then, अन्योन्यम् each other, दातारम् the giver, अभिजग्मतुः approached, तौ those two, राजभवनद्वारि at the palace gate, न not, प्राप्तौ obtained, नृगशासनम् Nṛga's command.
explanation: Then, disputing with each other, they approached the giver (King Nṛga), but those two did not meet King Nṛga at the palace gate.

shloka_text: अहोरात्राण्यनेकानि वसन्तौ क्रोधमीयतुः । ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ तावुभौ द्विजसत्तमौ ।। क्रुद्धौ परमसम्प्राप्तौ वाक्यं घोराभिसंहितम् ।। 7.53.17 ।।
transliteration: ahorātrāṇyanekāni vasantau krodhamīyatuḥ | ūcatuśca mahātmānau tāvubhau dvijasattamau || kruddhau paramasamprāptau vākyaṃ ghorābhisaṃhitam || 7.53.17 ||
translation: अहोरात्राणि days and nights, अनेकानि many, वसन्तौ staying, क्रोधम् anger, ईयतुः reached, ऊचतुः spoke, च and, महात्मानौ great-souled ones, तौ those, उभौ both, द्विजसत्तमौ best among brahmins, क्रुद्धौ angry, परमसम्प्राप्तौ having reached the highest, वाक्यम् words, घोराभिसंहितम् terrible and connected.
explanation: After staying for many days and nights, those two great-souled and best among brahmins became exceedingly angry and spoke terrible words filled with a curse.

shloka_text: अर्थिनां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं यस्मात्त्वं नैषि दर्शनम् । अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां कृकलासो भविष्यसि ।। 7.53.18 ।।
transliteration: arthināṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yasmāttvaṃ naiṣi darśanam | adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kṛkalāso bhaviṣyasi || 7.53.18 ||
translation: अर्थिनाम् of petitioners, कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् for the accomplishment of their purpose, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, न not, एषि go, दर्शनम् sight, अदृश्यः invisible, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, कृकलासः a chameleon, भविष्यसि you will become.
explanation: Because you do not grant an audience to petitioners for the accomplishment of their purpose, you shall become a chameleon, invisible to all beings.

shloka_text: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि बहुवर्षशतानि च । श्वभ्रे ऽस्मिन् कृकलासो वै दीर्घकालं वसिष्यसि ।। 7.53.19 ।।
transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi bahuvarṣaśatāni ca | śvabhre 'smin kṛkalāso vai dīrghakālaṃ vasiṣyasi || 7.53.19 ||
translation: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, बहुवर्षशतानि many hundreds of years, च and, श्वभ्रे in this pit, अस्मिन् this, कृकलासो a chameleon, वै indeed, दीर्घकालं for a long time, वसिष्यसि you will reside.
explanation: For many thousands and hundreds of years, you will indeed reside in this pit as a chameleon for a long duration.

shloka_text: उत्पत्स्यते हि लोके ऽस्मिन्यदूनां कीर्तिवर्धनः । वासुदेव इति ख्यातो विष्णुः पुरुषविग्रहः ।। 7.53.20 ।।
transliteration: utpatsyate hi loke 'sminyadūnāṃ kīrtivardhanaḥ | vāsudeva iti khyāto viṣṇuḥ puruṣavigrahaḥ || 7.53.20 ||
translation: उत्पत्स्यते will be born, हि indeed, लोके in the world, अस्मिन् this, यदूनां of the Yadus, कीर्तिवर्धनः increaser of fame, वासुदेव Vasudeva, इति thus named, ख्यातो renowned, विष्णुः Vishnu, पुरुषविग्रहः having a human form.
explanation: Indeed, in this world, Vishnu, renowned as Vasudeva, the increaser of the Yadus' glory and having a human form, will be born.

shloka_text: स ते मोक्षयिता राजंस्तस्माच्छापाद्भविष्यसि । कृता च तेन कालेन निष्कृतिस्ते भविष्यति ।। 7.53.21 ।।
transliteration: sa te mokṣayitā rājaṃstasmācchāpādbhaviṣyasi | kṛtā ca tena kālena niṣkṛtiste bhaviṣyati || 7.53.21 ||
translation: स He, ते your, मोक्षयिता liberator, राजंस् O King, तस्मात् from that, शापात् curse, भविष्यसि you will be, कृता done, च and, तेन by him, कालेन by time, निष्कृतिस् expiation, ते your, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: O King, he will be your liberator from that curse, and by him, your expiation will be accomplished in due course.

shloka_text: भारावतरणार्थं हि नरनारायणावुभौ । उत्पत्स्येते महावीर्यौ कलौ युग उपस्थिते ।। 7.53.22 ।।
transliteration: bhārāvataraṇārthaṃ hi naranārāyaṇāvubhau | utpatsyete mahāvīryau kalau yuga upasthite || 7.53.22 ||
translation: भारावतरणार्थं for the purpose of alleviating the burden, हि indeed, नरनारायणौ Nara and Narayana, उभौ both, उत्पत्स्येते will be born, महावीर्यौ greatly powerful, कलौ in the Kali, युगे in the age, उपस्थिते when it has arrived.
explanation: Indeed, both Nara and Narayana, greatly powerful, will be born for the purpose of alleviating the earth's burden when the Kali Yuga has arrived.

shloka_text: एवं तौ शापमुत्सृज्य ब्राह्मणौ विगतज्वरौ । तां गां हि दुर्बलां वृद्धां ददतुर्ब्राह्मणाय वै ।। 7.53.23 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ tau śāpamutsṛjya brāhmaṇau vigatajvarau | tāṃ gāṃ hi durbalāṃ vṛddhāṃ dadaturbrāhmaṇāya vai || 7.53.23 ||
translation: एवं thus, तौ those two, शापम् curse, उत्सृज्य having uttered, ब्राह्मणौ the two Brahmins, विगतज्वरौ free from distress, तां that, गां cow, हि indeed, दुर्बलां weak, वृद्धां old, ददतुर् they gave, ब्राह्मणाय to a Brahmin, वै indeed.
explanation: Thus, having pronounced the curse, those two Brahmins, now free from distress, indeed gave that weak, old cow to a Brahmin.

shloka_text: एवं स राजा तं शापमुपभुङ्क्ते सुदारुणम् ।। 7.53.24 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā taṃ śāpamupabhuṅkte sudāruṇam || 7.53.24 ||
translation: एवं thus, सः that, राजा king, तम् that, शापम् curse, उपभुङ्क्ते experiences, सुदारुणम् very terrible.
explanation: In this manner, that king experiences that very terrible curse.

shloka_text: कार्यार्थिनां विमर्दो हि राज्ञां दोषाय कल्पते । तच्छीघ्रं दर्शनं मह्यमभिवर्तन्तु कार्यिणः ।। 7.53.25 ।।
transliteration: kāryārthināṃ vimardo hi rājñāṃ doṣāya kalpate | tacchīghraṃ darśanaṃ mahyamabhivartantu kāryiṇaḥ || 7.53.25 ||
translation: कार्यार्थिनाम् of those seeking their purpose, विमर्दः crowding, हि indeed, राज्ञाम् for kings, दोषाय for harm, कल्पते leads to, तत् therefore, शीघ्रम् quickly, दर्शनम् audience, मह्यम् to me, अभिवर्तन्तु let them approach, कार्यिणः petitioners.
explanation: Indeed, the crowding of petitioners leads to harm for kings; therefore, let the petitioners quickly approach me for an audience.

shloka_text: सुकृतस्य हि कार्यस्य फलं नापैति पार्थिवः । तस्माद्गच्छ प्रतीक्षस्व सौमित्रे कार्यवाञ्जनः ।। 7.53.26 ।।
transliteration: sukṛtasya hi kāryasya phalaṃ nāpaiti pārthivaḥ | tasmādgaccha pratīkṣasva saumitre kāryavāñjanaḥ || 7.53.26 ||
translation: सुकृतस्य of a well-done, हि indeed, कार्यस्य of work, फलम् the fruit, न not, अपैति is lost, पार्थिवः O king, तस्मात् therefore, गच्छ go, प्रतीक्षस्व wait, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, कार्यवान् one who has business, जनः person.
explanation: Indeed, the fruit of a well-done work is not lost, O king; therefore, O son of Sumitra, go and wait for any person who has business. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 53 ।। Thus ends the fifty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
